solver: faithful JS port of pr13:src/player/StaticCollisionWorld.ts (see pr13-mesh-solver.mjs)

method.geometry: box approach floor + solid triangular wedge + box top platform
method.popMetric: per-tick |dy| minus the legit ramp climb grade*|dz| minus 5 mm tolerance; 0 on a perfectly followed ramp

verdictReason: The prior mesh solver produced an uncommanded vertical pop of 154.2 mm in a single 120 Hz tick on a finite 37.5 deg solid ramp it rates fully walkable, while still reporting itself grounded. The defect switches on sharply near 26.6 deg: gentler ramps (16.7, 20.1, 23.4 deg) stay smooth. This is the class of defect that blocked PRs #3/#13 -- reproduced concretely on a finite solid, and worse than the original 45-57 mm report. It is why the shipped slice restricts the world to axis-aligned boxes, where a ramp cannot be expressed and this solver path is unreachable. A future slope solver must drive this pop to ~0 before slopes return.
